subject: Sales → CS: Mediflow rollout ledger, network blockers & owner assignment
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sana Patel <sana@mediflow.com>, Amir Chaudhry <amir.chaudhry@mediflow.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Sales → CS: Mediflow rollout ledger, network blockers & owner assignment

Hi team,

Wrapping up the commercial side for Mediflow (deal RW-2027-5873) — SOW just signed this morning (attached). Goal: a staged rollout starting May 10 with a 2-week pilot (10 seats) followed by org-wide ramp. Customer timeline is firm due to a regulatory demo the week of May 24.

Key context and asks (high priority):
- Customer contacts: Sana (PM) and Amir (IT lead).
- Pilot scope: basic chat + embeddings (no tool-calling or external connectors in phase 1).
- Network: Mediflow requires IP allow-listing and outbound TLS to our dedicated ingestion endpoint. They also asked for a one-hour joint network review with their security team.
- Data residency: US only — no EU regions.
- Success criteria for pilot: < 300ms p95 generation for 512 tokens, and no privacy incidents in 30 days.

Attachments: signed_SOW_v2.pdf, mediflow_network_requirements.xlsx, initial_integration_notes.txt

Requested next steps:
1) Tessa — can you own the engagement? If yes, please assign an implementation lead and propose an intake call time.
2) Ben/Karthik — technical notes below. Please add any known risks or required prework.

Thanks — I’ll hand off post-intake unless you need me in the kickoff.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference

---
Redwood internal note: customer sensitive to latency and unit cost. Budget locked; little room for scope creep.
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sana Patel <sana@mediflow.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: Mediflow rollout ledger, network blockers & owner assignment

Kimberly / Tessa — thanks for the summary. A few technical clarifications from my side:

- Model selection: recommend starting with the rdx-large-quant variant (good balance of latency/cost for 512 tokens). We can failover to rdx-medium if they push throughput.
- Authentication: they should use per-service-account API keys; advise rotating keys every 90 days.
- KV/prefix caching: enabling prefix caching for their common prompts will drop token cost ~18% — I'll provide a short list of candidate prefixes.
- Network items: confirmed: outbound TLS to ingestion.redwood-us.prod (443) + static IPs (list attached in spreadsheet). Mediflow IT will need those added to firewall rules.
- Data flow: ensure logs sent to Mediflow-owned S3 for audit retention (30 days). We will need their S3 IAM details during setup.

Risks / open questions:
- If they insist on on-prem model execution, that's out of scope for the signed SOW.
- We should schedule a joint network call this week — propose Wed Apr 21, 10:00–11:00 PT.

I'll drop a short tech memo to the GH ticket after this.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Sana Patel <sana@mediflow.com>, Amir Chaudhry <amir.chaudhry@mediflow.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales → CS: Mediflow rollout ledger, network blockers & owner assignment

Thanks — I can take ownership of the engagement.

Owner assignments (internal):
- Engagement Lead: Tessa Morgan (tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com) — primary CS contact and responsible for milestone signoffs.
- Implementation Engineer: Karthik Iyer (karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com) — responsible for environment setup, connector configuration, and testing.
- Solutions support (technical advisory): Ben Carter — available for escalations during kickoff and pilot.

Planned intake / kickoff cadence:
1) Intake call (30 min) — Tue Apr 20, 2027 09:00–09:30 PT — attendees: Tessa, Karthik, Ben, Sana, Amir. Purpose: confirm pilot scope, network checklist, credentials handoff.
2) Network review (60 min) — Wed Apr 21, 2027 10:00–11:00 PT — technical deep-dive with Mediflow IT.
3) Pilot prep window (Apr 22–May 7) — environment provisioning, runbook creation, test scripts.
4) Pilot kickoff (May 10) — go/no-go decision meeting scheduled for May 24.

Prework requests for Mediflow (Sana / Amir):
- Provide S3 IAM role and temporary test creds by Apr 22.
- Confirm firewall entry for Redwood static IPs by Apr 21 (network call).
- Share a short list of 6–8 representative prompts for caching recommendations.

I've created a starter runbook and entered the milestones into our project tracker (link below). I'll own weekly status updates and escalate blockers if they threaten the May 10 target.

Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Senior Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference

Related tracker: https://app.redwoodinference.com/projects/mediflow-5873/runbook

Hi Tessa / team — thanks for the clear plan and for taking ownership.

We can do the intake call Tue 9:00 PT — confirmed. Amir will join the network review on Wed. I pulled the signed SOW into our procurement folder and uploaded a copy to our internal tracker (link below).

I'll have the S3 role and a short prompt list to you by EOD Apr 22. For the firewall, our security team has requested the full static IP list ahead of Wed so they can pre-approve before the call — I attached a short note on their checklist.

One ask from our side: can Redwood provide a short pilot acceptance checklist (what you will validate during the 2-week pilot) before Apr 22? That will help our internal stakeholders align expectations.

Thanks — Sana
Sana Patel
Product Manager — Mediflow Health
